text:
jamie (docs): opened PR #903 to refresh SDK snippets (python + js) and add a short migration note for Dedicated -> Private. Preview link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/903/files. CI preview failing on linkcheck + vale + spellcheck. can someone triage?

ci-bot: docs-ci/linkcheck · failed
  5 broken links:
   - docs/snippets/python/auth.md: line 9 -> https://old-docs.example.com/auth (timeout)
   - docs/snippets/js/quickstart.md: line 4 -> /snippets/js/old-init.md (file missing)
   - docs/migrate/dedicated-to-private.md: line 45 -> http://internal.example.local/network (unreachable)
   - docs/overview/terms.md: line 12 -> https://example.com/terms (403)
   - docs/snippets/python/examples.md: line 22 -> https://gist.github.com/404 (404)
Run `make docs-linkcheck` or inspect log: https://ci.redwood.io/builds/331002

ci-bot: docs-ci/vale · failed
  Rules: PassiveVoice (3), Contractions (1), Complexity (1)
  Excerpt: "the token is stored temporarily" -> suggest: "store the token temporarily"

ci-bot: docs-ci/spellcheck · failed
  Noted: lowercase `redwood` and `vpc` in headings. Style: `Redwood`, `VPC`.

alex (devex): I can take the broken links. Most look like stale internal hosts or renamed snippets. Will grep for `/snippets/js/old-init.md` references and update to `/snippets/js/init.md`.

lina (eng): I'll handle the vale passive voice rewrites. will avoid changing inline code blocks. prefer short active phrases.

jamie (docs): thanks. pls keep changes small — no diagram edits in this PR. also, the migration note references a cluster ID example we shouldn't publish; i'll scrub that out.

alex (devex): quick patch locally:
```bash
git checkout -b docs/903-linkfix
rg "/snippets/js/old-init.md" -l | xargs -I{} sed -i 's|/snippets/js/old-init.md|/snippets/js/init.md|g' {}
# replace internal host for the auth link to relative
rg "https://old-docs.example.com" -l | xargs -L1 sed -i 's|https://old-docs.example.com|/snippets/python/auth.md|g'
```

alex (devex): pushed linkfix branch. CI re-run queued, linkcheck should pass for the snippet paths.

lina (eng): Pushed small copy changes for active voice, left one comment about clarifying "rotation window" but not blocking.

ci-bot: docs-ci/linkcheck · success
ci-bot: docs-ci/vale · pending
ci-bot: docs-ci/spellcheck · pending

jamie (docs): great. can someone approve the PR after checks are green? i'd like to merge before tomorrow's doc release.

yusuf (docs): reviewing now. will add `docs/approved` if green.

ci-bot: docs-ci/vale · failed (new run)
  Rules: Complexity (1) in docs/migrate/dedicated-to-private.md paragraph about routing. suggestion: split sentence.

lina (eng): reworded the routing paragraph into two sentences and simplified the conditional. pushed amend.

ci-bot: docs-ci/all · success (10m)

jamie (docs): added `docs/approved` label and `release/docs-sprint-9` tag. merging when CI completes. thanks! :tada:

alex (devex): nice fast loop. will follow up with a tiny PR to add a redirect for the old auth gist that we can't restore.

ci-bot: docs-ci/all · success (merge queue)

jamie (docs): merged. backported the heading casing fixes to main. closing PR #903.

lina (eng): thanks everyone. quick reminder: if vale flags PassiveVoice in troubleshooting steps, prefer active constructions that keep the steps intact.
